instruction.title: “Galogenlar” mavzusi bo‘yicha tajribaviy masalalar yechish
instruction.goal: Xlorid kislota tarkibida vodorod va xlor ionlari mavjudligini tajriba yo‘li bilan isbotlang.

steps.text: Xlorid kislota tarkibida vodorod va xlor ionlari mavjudligini tajriba yo‘li bilan isbotlang.
Berilgan quruq tuz natriy xlorid ekanini tajriba bilan isbotlang.
Probirkadagi eritma natriy yodid ekanini isbotlang.
Rux xlorid tuzini tajriba yo‘li bilan to‘rt xil usulda oling.
Berilgan quruq tuz namunasining bromid ekanini isbotlang.
Ikki probirkadagi NaCl va Na2CO3 tuzlarini tajriba yo‘li bilan farqlang.

procedure.orderSource: No order is declared: the instruction states problems ("… isbotlang"), and the config (reference-slices, reagentShelf) lets the learner choose reagents. Only state preconditions apply (two solutions before mixing; an observed reaction before recording).

No volume is declared, so no quantity parameter is offered.
Six problems; only problem 2 ("natriy xlorid ekanini … isbotlang") is grounded, by the config target rxn.agno3-nacl. Problems 1 and 3–6 are not offered.

The instruction neither contains nor authorizes WASH, so it is not offered (ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_TOPIC). One attempt can mix one pair per tube (two tubes). To test another pair, the learner uses the lab-level RESET, which restores the initial state and is not chemistry. The existing runtime let a learner mix any number of pairs in one attempt; that convenience is not reproduced.

instruction.title: Platforma uchun demonstratsion tajriba nomzodi: elektroliz
instruction.equipmentText: Elektrolizyor yoki elektrolitik vanna, elektrodlar, o‘zgarmas tok manbai.
instruction.safetyText: Elektr toki va xlor hosil bo‘lish ehtimoli sabab faqat o‘qituvchi demonstratsiyasi yoki raqamli simulyatsiya shaklida tavsiya etiladi.

steps.text: Elektrolizyorga CuCl2 eritmasini quying.
Eritmaga ikki elektrod tushiring. Bir elektrodni manfiy qutbga, ikkinchisini musbat qutbga ulang.
Manfiy elektrod katod, musbat elektrod anod ekanini belgilang.
Tok manbaini ulang. Cu2+ kationlarining katod tomon, Cl− anionlarining anod tomon harakatlanishini kuzating.
Katodda mis ajralishi va anodda xlor hosil bo‘lishini tushuntiring.

instruction.title: Aralashmalar tarkibidan sof moddani ajratish: ifloslangan osh tuzini tozalash
instruction.goal: 20 ml distillangan suvga ifloslangan osh tuzidan oz-ozdan soling va shisha tayoqcha bilan aralashtiring. Tuz erimay qolguncha davom eting.
instruction.equipmentText: Shtativ, spirt lampa, voronka, shisha tayoqcha, stakanlar, buyum oynasi, probirka tutqichi, filtr qog‘ozi.

steps.text: 20 ml distillangan suvga ifloslangan osh tuzidan oz-ozdan soling va shisha tayoqcha bilan aralashtiring. Tuz erimay qolguncha davom eting.

Kvadrat filtr qog‘ozini to‘rt buklang, chetini yoy shaklida qirqing, konus ko‘rinishida oching va voronkaga joylashtiring. Filtr qog‘ozining yuqori cheti voronka chetidan taxminan 0,5 sm past bo‘lsin.
Loyqa eritmani shisha tayoqcha orqali filtrlang. Voronkadan o‘tgan tiniq eritma filtrat hisoblanadi.
Filtratni chinni kosachaga quying va shtativda qizdirib bug‘lating. Sachrashning oldini olish uchun aralashtiring.
Tuz kristallari paydo bo‘la boshlaganda qizdirishni to‘xtating. Ajratilgan sof tuzni kuzating.

instruction.title: Kislotalarning metallar bilan o‘zaro ta’siri
instruction.goal: Magniy ustiga suyultirilgan H2SO4 quying, ajralgan gazni yig‘ing va gugurt alangasi bilan tekshiring.
instruction.equipmentText: Probirkalar, shtativ, gaz yig‘ish vositasi, gugurt.
instruction.materialsText: Mg, Zn, Cu; suyultirilgan H2SO4 va HCl.
instruction.safetyText: Vodorod miqdori probirka hajmining 1/3 qismidan oshmasin.

steps.text: Magniy ustiga suyultirilgan H2SO4 quying, ajralgan gazni yig‘ing va gugurt alangasi bilan tekshiring.
Rux granulalari ustiga HCl quying. Reaksiyani kuzating, zarur bo‘lsa biroz qizdiring, gazni yig‘ing va tekshiring.
Mis qirindilari ustiga suyultirilgan HCl quying. Qizdirilganda ham sezilarli o‘zgarish bo‘lmasligini kuzating.
Metallarning kislotalar bilan reaksiyaga kirishish qobiliyatini faollik qatori bilan izohlang.

procedure.orderSource: No order is declared: the config (guided-labs) runs on the generic runtime, whose order is only the array position (ORDER_FROM_ARRAY_POSITION). The three metal–acid trials are independent; only state preconditions apply.

Vodorod miqdori probirka hajmining 1/3 qismidan oshmasin.

gaps.detail: "gugurt alangasi bilan tekshiring": the flame test needs the oxygen of the air, which no source declares, and ignition is not a lab action here. It is not offered.

Step 3 (Cu + dilute HCl): no ReactionMatcher record covers this pair, so the lab shows no outcome (UNSUPPORTED_CHEMISTRY, fail closed). The step-bound school model school.cu-hcl.no-reaction is not a reaction record and is not consumed. This is a missing model/source, not a choice: it stays fail-closed until a reviewed source exists.
Step 4 ("faollik qatori bilan izohlang") is a learner response with no checker; it is not offered.

The equipment lists no burner. Heating comes only from the instruction verb, and its level from "biroz qizdiring" (gently-heated). Heating is in scope only for the Zn + HCl trial (step 2); the Cu + HCl trial states no heating operation, so HEAT there is ACTION_NOT_IN_INSTRUCTION_SCOPE.
"shtativ" and "gugurt" are listed but no offered action uses them.

instruction.title: Ammoniy tuziga so‘ndirilgan ohak ta’sir ettirib ammiak olish
instruction.goal: NH4Cl va so‘ndirilgan ohakning 1,5:1 massa nisbatidagi aralashmasini probirkaga soling va gaz o‘tkazgich nayli tiqin bilan yoping.
instruction.materialsText: NH4Cl, so‘ndirilgan ohak, suv, fenolftalein shimdirilgan qog‘oz, HCl ga botirilgan shisha tayoqcha.

steps.text: NH4Cl va so‘ndirilgan ohakning 1,5:1 massa nisbatidagi aralashmasini probirkaga soling va gaz o‘tkazgich nayli tiqin bilan yoping.
Aralashmani biroz qizdiring va ajralgan gazni probirkalarga yig‘ing.
Gaz bilan to‘lgan probirkani suvga botirib, suvning probirkaga kirishini kuzating.
Gaz oqimiga fenolftaleinli qog‘oz tuting.
Gaz oqimiga HCl ga botirilgan shisha tayoqchani yaqinlashtiring va oq tutunni kuzating.
